Airport Authority Explores Private Investment Options

The Greater Toronto Airports Authority (GTAA) is exploring options for private investment in Toronto Pearson International Airport. The GTAA stated that discussions are underway regarding potential private investment models. Major international airports such as London Heathrow and Sydney Airport already operate with private investment. The GTAA indicated that these models could be considered for Pearson Airport.
